name: Stearns Wharf
blurb: Santa Barbara's historic pier at the end of State Street — shops, views, and the beach.

name: Santa Barbara County Courthouse
blurb: A Spanish-Moorish landmark with a clock tower and views over downtown.

name: Granada Theatre
blurb: A restored 1920s movie palace on State Street — concerts and films downtown.

name: Arlington Theatre
blurb: An outdoor-style theatre on State Street, built inside a former mortuary chapel.

name: Funk Zone
blurb: The arts and wine district between the freeway and the waterfront.

name: Old Mission Santa Barbara
blurb: The 'Queen of the Missions' — a hilltop landmark just above downtown.

name: El Presidio de Santa Bárbara
blurb: The last Spanish fort in California — adobe walls and a chapel near State Street.

name: Casa de la Guerra
blurb: A 19th-century adobe home of a Spanish military commander — now a downtown museum.

name: Santa Barbara Museum of Art
blurb: Paintings and sculpture on State Street, steps from the courthouse.

name: MOXI Museum
blurb: Hands-on science and creativity museum near the train station and waterfront.

name: Santa Barbara Public Library
blurb: The central library on Anapamu Street — a quiet landmark between State and the courthouse.

name: Santa Barbara Amtrak Station
blurb: The Spanish-colonial train station where Amtrak stops beside the waterfront.

name: Santa Barbara Historical Museum
blurb: Stories and artifacts from Santa Barbara's past, near El Presidio.

name: Alice Keck Park
blurb: A downtown park with a koi pond, gardens, and turtles kids love to spot.

name: Paseo Nuevo
blurb: An open-air shopping plaza on State Street with courtyards and fountains.
